test_title: PYST 13 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 17 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice:**

The guide said, "We will be exploring the ruins all morning."

options.text: The guide said that they would be exploring the ruins all morning.
The guide said that they will be exploring the ruins all morning.
The guide said that we would be exploring the ruins all morning.
The guide said that we will be exploring the ruins all morning.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** The guide said, "We will be exploring the ruins all morning."
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Pronoun Change:**
 
 
• The first-person plural pronoun **"We"** in direct speech refers to the guide and the group. When reported by someone else, it typically changes to the third-person plural **"they."**
 
 
 
• **Modal Verb Change (Backshifting):**
 
 
• Since the reporting verb **"said"** is in the past tense, the future modal **"will"** shifts to its past form, **"would."**
 
 
 
• **Tense Maintenance:**
 
 
• The continuous aspect **"be exploring"** remains unchanged after the shifted modal verb.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The guide said that they would be exploring the ruins all morning."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Corrects the pronoun but fails to shift the tense from "will" to "would."
 
• **Option 3:** Corrects the tense but fails to change the pronoun "we" to "they," which is standard in indirect reporting unless the reporter is part of the group.
 
• **Option 4:** Fails to change both the pronoun and the tense.
